instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Energy services company providing energy efficiency audits, HVAC optimization, and building management system integration for commercial and industrial clients. Completed 200+ projects across hospitals, hotels, and manufacturing plants. Developing an IoT-based real-time energy monitoring platform. The company has mature core business processes but struggles with the tension between running the existing operation efficiently and carving out resources for innovation. We have pockets of digital maturity in specific teams while other areas rely heavily on manual workflows and spreadsheets.
answers.pastInitiatives: We installed IoT sensors on 40% of our production equipment to monitor utilization and predict failures. The pilot showed a 15% reduction in unplanned downtime on instrumented machines. We now have a business case approved for full fleet rollout, but procurement and integration with our legacy maintenance system are proving more complex than anticipated.
answers.strategicGoals: We are heavily dependent on a single product category and a concentrated customer base — our top 3 clients represent 55% of revenue. This concentration risk is unacceptable for our long-term health. We need to identify and develop new revenue streams, possibly including new product lines for different customer segments or entirely new business models that leverage our existing capabilities.
answers.teamSize: The technology organization is structured into product-aligned squads with a central platform team of 5 engineers enabling shared infrastructure. Innovation is driven by a '20% time' policy where all engineers can dedicate one day per sprint to self-directed projects, plus a quarterly internal pitch competition where winning ideas receive seed funding and 3 months of dedicated squad allocation.

input.changes_since_last: Regulatory changes forced compliance reviews. 6 new standard procedures implemented. Team morale improving.

opportunities.title: Industrial Predictive Maintenance Service Line Rollout
opportunities.rationale: Building on the successful IoT pilot, scaling this platform offers immediate de-risking of core service revenue. This incremental growth stabilizes current operations while building technical expertise needed for future diversification efforts.

first_actions: Map out compliance requirements (e.g., data privacy, industry standards) for the full fleet rollout.
Integrate necessary regulatory checkpoints into the maintenance workflow documentation.
Pilot deployment with a non-critical client segment to manage initial integration complexity.
resources_needed: Budget allocation for legacy system APIs
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieving 80% sensor coverage on target equipment types with successful data ingestion and compliance audit sign-off.
milestones: Phase 2: Integration with 5 key legacy systems (Q4)
Phase 3: Commercialization model approved for new client segment (Q1 next year)

opportunities.title: Developing Micro-Service Subscription Models for Non-Core Clients
opportunities.rationale: To address the critical concentration risk (55% from top 3 clients), focus on developing standardized, non-custom solutions. This diversification effort allows the company to tap into smaller industrial/commercial segments without requiring massive internal process overhauls.

first_actions: Conduct market segmentation analysis focused on underrepresented industry verticals (e.g., mid-sized manufacturing, specialized logistics).
Define 3 standardized service offerings that use existing BMS/HVAC expertise but are decoupled from large client contracts.
Develop a low-touch sales pitch and initial pricing model for these micro-services.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Securing proof-of-concept interest from 5 new, non-core client segments.
milestones: Market gap analysis completed and prioritized (Q3)
MVP for the first micro-service defined and scoped (Q4)
Pilot sale executed in a new segment (Q1 next year)

next_steps.action: Formalize a Compliance-by-Design checklist for all new digital product rollouts to proactively manage regulatory risk.
Establish a dedicated, cross-functional 'Diversification Task Force' (including Sales and Product) with clear KPIs focused solely on the top 3 micro-service targets.
Implement process mapping workshops to quantify manual workflow time, allowing for accurate resource allocation modeling between Operations (Run) and Innovation (Grow).

key_weaknesses: High dependency on top client base (Concentration Risk)
Structural tension between efficiently running core operations and dedicating resources to innovation.
Residual reliance on manual, non-standardized workflows in specific departmental processes.

improvements: Proactive compliance review mechanisms are now integrated into the process (6 new procedures implemented).
The '20% time' policy and pitch competition provide strong, structured channels for self-directed innovation.
Successful IoT pilot provided verifiable ROI data (15% downtime reduction), building business case strength.
persistent_gaps: Lack of a formalized process for transitioning successful pilots into standardized, repeatable service offerings.
The strategic balance between optimizing existing complex client relationships and developing new markets remains unresolved.
Operational resources are still under-measured against potential innovation gains.
achieved_milestones: Successful approval of the full fleet IoT rollout business case.
Improvement in team morale and adoption of standardized compliance procedures.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: The company has matured its internal processes significantly, moving from planning to execution in core areas (IoT rollout). The focus shifted explicitly toward mitigating client concentration risk and formalizing compliance procedures due to external regulatory pressures.
